[[Oberan the Reviled]] requires your help to eliminate [[Crypt Fiend]]s drawn to his dark experiments. They will shamble down the corridor toward you one by one.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| profession = necromancer
| test = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Go south and destroy all the crypt fiends there.
* Destroy [5..0] more crypt fiends.
* Return to Oberan the Reviled for your reward.

===Early benefits===
* Oberan the Reviled will give you the following skills upon taking the quest:
** {{skill icon|Faintheartedness}}
** {{skill icon|Soul Barbs}}

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
Oberan can be hard to find for new players; however, the quest [[Charr in the Catacombs]] from [[Prince Rurik]] will lead the player straight to Oberan.

Upon accepting the quest, the Crypt Fiends will start spawning one at a time and approach through the long southern hallway. The crypt fiends have no skills and attack at melee range with low damage output, so they are not difficult to defeat. Just kill all 5 and collect your reward. 

Faintedheartedness is a very weak [[hex]], and its main use is to trigger Soul Barbs' damage. Soul Barbs, on the other hand, is quite strong and works with all hexes, including [[Siphon Strength]] and [[mesmer]] hexes such as [[Conjure Phantasm]] and [[Imagined Burden]].

An easy way to finish this quest is to hide behind the wall behind Oberan so that the Crypt Fiends will get stuck trying to reach you as they will be [[bodyblock]]ed by him. You will then be able to slowly kill them with ranged spells.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Oberan the Reviled
:''"Working here in the catacombs protects me from the prying eyes of the living, but my necromantic experiments have begun to attract the attention of creatures from beyond the pale. I'd like to continue my work without interruption by these infernal beasts.''

:''"If you go south and eliminate the '''crypt fiends''' that have been bothering me, I will share with you a few of my most essential Curses. Then you too will see that the true power in the Necromancer's art lies not merely in the manipulation of the dead." ''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Consider it a bargain.
| decline = I'm not sure I can handle this.
| ask = Don't squander the power I have placed at your fingertips! The '''crypt fiends''' are not far from here. The demons cannot help but be drawn to the dark forces I command.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Oberan the Reviled
:''"Excellent. I shall be glad to be rid of those fiends. You show promise in the art of Necromancy."''

==Notes==
* [[Karleen]], the universal collector for foot armor pieces in [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|pre-Searing]] (collecting [[Gargoyle Skull]]s), can be found a short way to the north of Oberan.
